title: route runner configuration
description: Tunables of factory/bin/route.sh. ${repo} is the directory above factory/ (or the --repo flag). No tunable lives in the script.

poll_seconds.description: seconds between ticks; the belt file is touched every tick, so this bounds how fresh it is

runner_seat.description: the seat name on every record the runner writes; records with this seat are never routed, which is what stops a receipt from being routed again

seat_bin.description: herdr/bin/seat.sh: the one way a seat comes up or goes down; the seat and down parts of a row call it, and a break-glass route runs it as seat.sh --break-glass SEAT --record ID; nothing else does

stale_seconds.description: age of the belt file past which route.sh status reports the belt stopped
